name: @lanka-playgrounds/svelte-spa
description: Atlas in Svelte: a Vite single-page application, with real components and the same ViewModels every other host reads.

scripts.//dev: The application, against the API on port 4380. Start the server first.
scripts.//build:app: NOT `build`. `pnpm verify:build` is `pnpm -r run build` and it exists to check what is PUBLISHED.
scripts.//typecheck: `svelte-check`, not `tsc`: a component is markup and script in one, and the TypeScript compiler cannot read one. A project that used `tsc` here would typecheck every file EXCEPT its components.
